citations.claim: first pole_upright violation at step 43 with theta 0.86 rad, energy greatly elevated
one step before failure pole already at 0.71 rad and diverging with high rate

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.0152448 to 0, keeping all other fields identical; noisy angle/rate feedback was driving instability, so removing noise stabilizes the run

explanation: Seeded sensor noise (0.0152) on pole angle/rate corrupts the fixed state-feedback controller's measurements. The controller reacts to false angle errors with large cart forces (e.g., ~40N at steps 40-43), injecting work (external_work ~36) that pumps energy (E ~37.5 vs E0 ~1.45) and drives theta from -0.2 at step 30 to 0.86 at step 43. Removing noise alone stabilizes the identical plant/initial conditions.
vision_note: The pole leans progressively farther to the right from step 40 to 42 while the cart drifts left. At step 43 the pole tip turns red at a large tilt, marking the pole-upright violation.
